qualifier: CXCL12–CXCR4 driven, in T, mast, dendritic cells and astrocytes
name: CXCL12–CXCR4 directed leukocyte and astrocyte chemotaxis
rationale: All members concern chemoattractant-guided migration (T, mast, dendritic cell and astrocyte chemotaxis, pseudopodium/Cdc42/PLC-PKC effectors) anchored by CXCL12–CXCR4, distinguishing it from the S1P/B-cell lymphoid-homing and chemokine-receptor/dendritic-cell neighbours.

qualifier: favouring astrocytes over neuronal and oligodendrocyte fates
name: Glial fate specification favouring astrocytes over neurons and oligodendrocytes
rationale: Members specify glial fate while promoting astrocyte and repressing neuron and oligodendrocyte differentiation, unlike neighbours about forebrain/retinal neurogenesis, neural stem cell division, spinal patterning or myelination.

name: Locomotor and sensorimotor behaviour with glycinergic inhibitory transmission
rationale: Members cover walking, righting reflex, proprioception, touch and motor control together with inhibitory (glycinergic, MECP2–GABA) neurotransmission, distinguishing it from grooming/vocal-learning behaviour neighbours and the neuronal excitability neighbour lacking locomotion.

qualifier: Hox-directed, with somitogenesis and hindbrain segmentation
name: Hox-directed embryonic axis patterning and somitogenesis
rationale: Members pattern the embryonic anterior-posterior and dorsal-ventral axes via Hox clusters, somite formation, rhombomeres and neural plate regionalisation, while neighbours concern axial mesoderm/neural tube, craniofacial organs or limbs and lack the Hox and somite members.

core: Ion transporter defects in tissue mineralization
name: Bicarbonate, phosphate and calcium exchanger defects in mineralization
rationale: Members are bicarbonate (SLC4), phosphate (SLC20A2, ABCC6) and Na/K/Ca exchanger (SLC24) transport and their disorders, mostly affecting enamel/tooth or ectopic mineralization and acid-base balance (SLC24A5 albinism is an outlier), unlike neighbours on carbonic anhydrase, dentin, SLC26 anion exchange or Na/Pi cotransport.

qualifier: efflux and reverse transport, restraining storage and synthesis
name: Cholesterol efflux, reverse transport and foam cell restraint
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse cholesterol transport, HDL clearance and LXR-driven export while restraining storage, foam cell formation and synthesis, unlike neighbours on SREBP-driven biosynthesis or HDL/LDL particle assembly and remodelling.

qualifier: upstream amino acid and energy sensing
name: Amino acid and energy sensing by mTORC1
rationale: Members all concern mTORC1 control by leucine/methionine, glucose starvation, LKB1–AMPK, AKT–TSC and lysosomal recruitment, unlike neighbours centred on glycolytic/p53 metabolic targets, FOXO or protein methylation.

name: Spliceosomal snRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation and transport
rationale: Members cover snRNP assembly, snRNA cap trimethylation and nuclear transport feeding the spliceosome, whereas neighbours concern snRNA transcription and splice-site recognition, mRNA decapping/decay or 3'-end processing.

name: Epithelial desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly
rationale: Members assemble intermediate filament-anchored desmosomes and hemidesmosomes in epithelial adhesion; neighbours lack hemidesmosomes and instead cover cardiac adhesion, apical/adherens junctions or cornification.

name: Nuclear protein import and export co-opted by respiratory viruses
rationale: Members regulate NLS-dependent protein import and export along with SARS-CoV and RSV nucleoprotein maturation and host targeting, unlike neighbours on nuclear pore/RNA export, SUMOylation or viral PDZ targeting.

name: Notch and Hedgehog signalling via regulated proteolysis and lipidation
rationale: Members span Notch receptor processing and intracellular-domain signalling, Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and GLI regulation, plus other intramembrane-proteolysis receptors (ERBB4, p75NTR), distinguishing it from Wnt destruction-complex and Wnt ligand-secretion neighbours.

name: p53-dependent intrinsic apoptosis after DNA damage
rationale: All members concern p53-mediated transcription of death genes and regulation of DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis, unlike neighbours on p53 expression/cofactors and cell-cycle arrest or the downstream BCL-2/apoptosome machinery.

name: Regulation of oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: The three members regulate oocyte maturation and its meiotic progression, including its inhibition, unlike neighbours on germ cell migration, ovarian follicle development or meiosis I spindle mechanics.

qualifier: protozoa and bacterial toxins, IL-10/IL-12 balance
name: Macrophage and dendritic cell responses to protozoa and bacterial toxins
rationale: Members are myeloid host-defence programmes (DC-SIGN, Fc receptor IL-10, IL-12, CD163, NADPH oxidase, GBPs, antigen presentation) against Leishmania/protozoa and anthrax/diphtheria toxin uptake, distinguishing it from neighbours on PMN respiratory burst, Mtb, fungal Dectin or Listeria entry.

qualifier: adaptor-mediated MAPK and CREB transcription arm
name: NGF–TRKA adaptor signalling to ERK5, p38 and CREB
rationale: Members describe TRKA signalling via FRS2/ARMS adaptors to ERK5, p38 and CREB-driven transcription, unlike neighbours on TRKB/TRKC signalling or TRKA activation, PLC-gamma, STAT3 and retrograde signalling.

core: Inflammatory lipid mediator metabolism and signalling
name: Lipoxygenase-derived leukotriene and lipoxin metabolism and signalling
rationale: Members centre on 5-/15-lipoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, HETEs), their catabolism, transport and GPCRs, with related histamine and PAF mediators, distinguishing it from cyclooxygenase prostaglandin, P450 epoxide and resolvin/maresin neighbours.

qualifier: epithelial apical polarity and cardiomyocyte desmosomal adhesion
name: Epithelial apical junctions, polarity and cardiomyocyte desmosomal adhesion
rationale: Members cover adherens/apical junction maintenance, apical-basal polarity and desmosomal cardiomyocyte adhesion, distinguishing it from cadherin-assembly neighbours and the hemidesmosome neighbour.

core: Heat shock and proteotoxic stress response
qualifier: stress granule and PML body dynamics
name: Heat shock and proteotoxic stress response with stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover HSF1 heat shock response, refolding, UPRmt and arsenite/PKR stress with stress granule and PML body organisation, the latter absent from neighbours on chaperonin folding, ER UPR, aggrephagy or protein acetylation.

qualifier: potassium channel-driven repolarization and resting potential
name: Potassium channel-driven cardiac action potential repolarization
rationale: Members describe cardiac plateau, repolarisation and resting phases via Kir, TWIK and voltage-gated K+ channels with calcium current restraint, unlike neighbours focused on depolarisation and His-Purkinje conduction or non-cardiac K+ channels.

name: Somitogenesis and posterior body axis elongation
rationale: All members concern somite formation, specification and polarity with tail/axis elongation, distinguishing it from neural plate, Hox, gastrulation and LFNG-segmentation-clock neighbours.

name: Activation and positive regulation of the alternative complement pathway
rationale: All three members concern activating the alternative complement pathway, whereas neighbours cover classical, lectin or general complement activation and its negative regulation.

qualifier: NIK-driven from TNF receptor superfamily and Dectin-1
name: NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kappaB signalling from TNFR superfamily and Dectin-1
rationale: Members concern NIK activation and non-canonical NF-kappaB from TNFSF receptors and Dectin-1, with TPL2–ERK output, unlike neighbours on canonical IKK/TLR/TNFR1 NF-kappaB or T/B cell receptor activation.

name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation control
rationale: Members cover carnitine transport and shuttle, long-chain fatty acid import and positive/negative control of beta-oxidation, unlike neighbours on ketone bodies, medium-chain/malonyl-CoA metabolism or other fatty acid transporters.

qualifier: with the photoreceptor retinoid cycle and its inherited defects
name: Phototransduction and visual retinoid cycle, including inherited retinal defects
rationale: Members cover opsin light detection, the phototransduction cascade and the rod/cone retinoid cycle with their disease variants, unlike neighbours on general retinoid/retinoic acid metabolism or photoreceptor development.

name: Sodium-coupled di- and tricarboxylate transmembrane transport
rationale: All members describe transport of succinate and other di-/tricarboxylates by sodium-coupled carriers, unlike neighbours on urea cycle or glutamate/aspartate metabolism.
